tracks.description: Tracks in order of preference: of two tracks that fit, the earlier one plays.

id.description: Stable track ID, unique in the list.

title.description: Name shown to the player while the track plays.

file.description: File name of the track in the music directory.

theme.description: The theme of the world: it plays when no other track fits.

scenes.description: Scene names, as the narrative uses them. The track plays only there. Absent: anywhere.

moods.description: Moods the track fits, by the names this world uses. Absent: the track does not answer a mood.

loop.description: `false` plays the track once. Defaults to true.

volume.description: Level of this track, from 0 to 1. Defaults to 1.

moods.description: The moods of this world's music, in the author's own words. The narrative is told these names and when each applies. Absent: the moods the tracks name, without a description.

id.description: The mood's name, as tracks use it.

when.description: When the story is in this mood, in one line.
